name: cube-coach
description: CubeCoach - Solve. Learn. Practice. Master the Cube.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared/cube-engine && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=shared/cube-engine && npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=shared/cube-engine && npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
